endorsements.name: Manu "The Sur"
endorsements.label: Owning Bad Guys {And Mafia} With Javascript Botnets
endorsements.description: Man in the middle attacks are still one of the most powerful techniques for owning machines. In this talk MITM schemas in anonymous services are going to be discussed. Then attendees will see how easily a botnet using javascript can be created to analyze that kind of connections and some of the actions people behind those services are doing... in real. It promises to be funny.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
